margherita.name: Margherita
margherita.description: The iconic Neapolitan pizza originating from Italy, made with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil. Known for its simplicity, balanced flavors, and light texture, it highlights the quality of traditional ingredients.

pepperoni.name: Pepperoni
pepperoni.description: A popular American-style pizza topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and spicy pepperoni sausage. Its bold, savory flavor and slightly crispy edges make it one of the most loved pizzas worldwide.

bbq_chicken.name: BBQ Chicken
bbq_chicken.description: A modern pizza variation using barbecue sauce instead of tomato sauce, topped with seasoned chicken breast, onion, and mozzarella. It offers a smoky, sweet flavor profile with a hearty, satisfying taste.

hawaiian.name: Hawaiian
hawaiian.description: A controversial yet famous pizza combining tomato sauce, mozzarella, ham, and pineapple. The contrast between sweet pineapple and salty ham creates a distinctive sweet-and-savory flavor experience.

vegetarian.name: Vegetarian
vegetarian.description: A meat-free pizza topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and a selection of fresh vegetables. It’s a lighter option that emphasizes freshness, variety, and natural flavors without sacrificing taste.
